title: CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.template recommends unsupported kbs list --long
description:
CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.template.md says:
  kbs list --status open --long

Result:
  error: unexpected argument '--long' found

Supported alternatives appear to be --full-ids, --porcelain, and --all.

Fix: align template (and any DEFAULT copy) with current list CLI flags.
right_now_summary: The template still tells agents to use the unsupported `--long` flag and needs updating.
